verdict.rationale: Otter documents an Android app to "record, transcribe, and access your meetings on the go" (otter-docs-60), and a hands-on user relies on the iOS app's record button for voice journaling, which is in-person capture (otter-comm-4). Recordings are searchable across all time periods and through natural-language AI Chat, and Channels group them in a shared space (otter-docs-18, otter-docs-11, otter-docs-1, otter-docs-51). missing for 10: explicit documentation that mobile-recorded in-person notes sync into the same searchable workspace as other meetings, first-party documentation of the iOS app, and independent corroboration of in-person mobile transcription quality.
